# HorizonCraft Studio

> HorizonCraft Studio is an independent 3D motion design studio creating cinematic 3D product animations, product launch films, photorealistic product-page visuals and website hero animations for brands.

## Website

- [Homepage](https://www.horizoncraft.studio/): The studio's main public page, including its showreel, displayed client references, services and contact details.

## Services

- **Product launch films:** Cinematic 3D product animation and launch films that introduce new products through visual storytelling.
- **Product detail page (PDP) visuals:** Photorealistic 3D product renders, animated loops and close-up detail views for product detail pages.
- **Website hero animations:** Scroll-ready 3D animation for product features and brand stories on website homepages.

## Displayed client references

The homepage currently displays logos for Apolnus, Brave, Kreo, Keiretsu Forum, Mort & Co and Qalzy.
